163: def projection(m: dict) -> dict:
164:     keys = ("t_A", "t_B", "v", "h", "L", "s_F", "r_F", "s_I", "r_I", "W_F", "W_I")
165:     if any(not np.isfinite(m[k]) or m[k] <= 0 for k in keys):
166:         raise ValueError("Actual positive finite H measurements required")
167:     train = 288*(m["t_A"]+m["t_B"])
168:     forward = 1446*m["v"]+36*m["h"]
169:     io = m["L"]+2*(m["s_F"]+m["r_F"]+m["s_I"]+m["r_I"])
170:     seconds = 1.25*(train+forward+io+1800)
171:     size = math.ceil(1.1*(m["W_F"]+2*m["W_I"]+2*2**30))
172:     return dict(train_seconds=train, forward_seconds=forward, io_seconds=io, unmeasured_allowance_seconds=1800,
173:                 projected_total_seconds=seconds, projected_peak_output_bytes=size,
174:                 within_budget=seconds <= 28800 and size <= 10*2**30)

177: def train_stage(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm, stage, root, budget, *, entry=None):
178:     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
179:     if parent.adam_step(optimizer) != (stage-1)*288:
180:         raise ValueError("Stage continuity differs")
181:     if memory is not None:
182:         memory.begin_stage(stage)
183:     before = None if memory is None else memory.summary()

185:     name = "AB"[stage-1]+"_"+arm
186:     budget.phase = name
187:     rows, captures = [], []
188:     for step, group in enumerate(schedule, 1):
189:         history, target = (None, None) if memory is None else memory.draw()
190:         row = entry.method.update(model, optimizer, group, history, target, c, arm, stage, step, budget.check)
191:         if parent.adam_step(optimizer) != (stage-1)*288+step:
192:             raise ValueError("Actual optimizer call missing")
193:         rows.append({**row, "step": step, "current_uid": group.uid, "history_uid": history.uid if history else None})
194:         if step % 48 == 0:
195:             captures.append(entry.method.capture(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm,
196:                 stage, step//48, root/"diagnostics", name, budget.check))
197:         if step == 1 or step % 24 == 0:
198:             print(data.json_bytes({"event": "updates", "point": name, "completed": step, **budget.snapshot()}).decode(), flush=True)
199:     after = None if memory is None else memory.summary()
200:     if before is not None and any(before[k] != after[k] for k in ("members", "seen", "origins", "tables")):
201:         raise ValueError("History targets/membership changed within B")
202:     path = root/"updates"/(name+".json")
203:     data.write_json(path, {"arm": arm, "stage": stage, "updates": 288, "adam_step": parent.adam_step(optimizer),
204:         "current_ids": [g.uid for g in schedule], "history_ids": [r["history_uid"] for r in rows if r["history_uid"]],
205:         "memory_before": before, "memory_after": after, "rows": rows})
206:     return data.record(path, root), captures

209: def memory_from(payload: bytes, arm: str, *, entry=None):
210:     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
211:     if arm not in entry.method.ARMS:

236: def checkpoint(root, name, model, optimizer, memory, current, calibration, valid, c, arm, stage, budget, *, entry=None):
237:     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
238:     if len(calibration) != 12 or len(valid) != 40 or parent.adam_step(optimizer) != 288*stage:
239:         raise ValueError("Endpoint scope differs")
240:     optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
241:     c = {**c, "pooling_stats": c.setdefault("pooling_stats", {}),

243:     state, modes = diag.rng_state(), [m.training for m in model.modules()]
244:     with diag.neutral(model):
245:         scores = {"calibration": entry.method.score(model, calibration, c, arm, budget.check),
246:                   "raw": entry.method.score(model, valid, c, arm, budget.check)}
247:         mapping = parent.calibration.fit(scores["calibration"], np.asarray([g.labels for g in calibration], np.uint8),
248:                                          role="calibration", check=budget.check)
249:         if mapping["status"] != "PASS_CALIBRATION_FIT":
250:             raise ValueError("Calibration failed; no retry")
251:         current_map = dict(zip(("a", "b"), parent.calibration.parameters(mapping)))

253:             memory = record.Memory(entry.method.RNG_ORDER)
254:         first_map = memory.maps.get("first", current_map)
255:         memory.maps = {"first": first_map, "stage": current_map, "rng": state,
256:                        "completed_stage": stage, "adam_step": stage*288, **entry.method.metadata(arm)}
257:         if stage == 1:
258:             memory.retain(current, 1, lambda g: record.reference(model, g, c, budget.check))
259:     mp = root/"memory"/(name+".bin")
260:     mp.write_bytes(memory.to_bytes())
261:     memory = entry.memory_from(mp.read_bytes(), arm)
262:     meta = {"name": name, "rng": state, "modes": modes, **entry.method.metadata(arm),
263:             "members": [g.uid for g in memory.reservoir.groups], "maps": memory.maps,
264:             "memory": data.record(mp, root), "policy_sha256": data.sha256(entry.POLICY)}
265:     full_path = root/"work"/(name+".pt")
266:     budget.check(base.persistence.checkpoint_reserve(model, optimizer))

268:     if entry.restore_point(full_path, full, model, optimizer, arm) != meta:
269:         raise ValueError("Full model/Adam restore mismatch")

271:         for role, groups in (("calibration", calibration), ("raw", valid)):
272:             restored = entry.method.restored_score(model, groups, c, budget.check)
273:             if not np.array_equal(scores[role], restored):
274:                 raise ValueError("Full restored scoring differs")
275:             scores["full-"+role] = restored
276:     model_path = root/"models"/(name+".pt")
277:     budget.check(base.persistence.checkpoint_reserve(model, None))
278:     inference = core.save_state(model_path, model, None, meta)
279:     if entry.restore_point(model_path, inference, model, None, arm) != meta:
280:         raise ValueError("Inference restore mismatch")
281:     with diag.neutral(model):
282:         for role, groups in (("calibration", calibration), ("raw", valid)):
283:             restored = entry.method.restored_score(model, groups, c, budget.check)

293:         "full_restore_verified": True, "inference_restore_verified": True, **entry.method.metadata(arm),
294:         "calibration_ids": [g.uid for g in calibration], "maps": {"first": first_map, "stage": current_map},
295:         "mapping": data.record(map_path, root), "memory": data.record(mp, root), "memory_summary": memory.summary(),

305: def train(job, budget, *, entry=None):
306:     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
307:     import torch
308:     root = job/"run"
309:     for sub in ("models", "work", "memory", "points", "scores", "maps", "updates", "diagnostics", "sources"):
310:         (root/sub).mkdir(parents=True)
311:     c = entry.config()
312:     baseline, old_root, old_col, old_manifest = entry.baseline_inputs()
313:     archive = entry.pretrained_archive(c)
314:     groups, metadata, checked = entry.public_inputs(c)
315:     if checked != old_manifest["public_inputs"]:
316:         raise ValueError("Formal input bytes differ from frozen S/G")
317:     _, split = entry.partition(groups, metadata, c)
318:     if split != data.read_json(old_root/"run/partition.json"):
319:         raise ValueError("H partition differs from frozen S/G")
320:     data.write_json(root/"partition.json", split)
321:     manifest = {"status": "RUNNING", "source_files": entry.sources(), "public_inputs": checked, "pretrained_archive": archive,
322:         "partition": data.record(root/"partition.json", root), "points": {}, "training": {}, "diagnostics": {},
323:         "baseline_identity": data.record(entry.BASELINE, data.ROOT), "initials": {}, "starts": {}, "physical_updates": 0, "gradient_group_presentations": 0}
324:     data.write_json(root/"startup.json", manifest)
325:     groups["train"] = previous.parse_once(job, groups["train"], c, "train",
326:         loader=lambda gs, cfg, s: entry.attach_labels(gs, cfg, s, metadata))
327:     selected, after = entry.partition(groups, metadata, c)
328:     if after != split:
329:         raise ValueError("Labels changed partition")
330:     def domain(role, d):
331:         return [g for g,r in zip(selected[role], split[role], strict=True) if r["domain"] == d]
332:     valid = groups["development"]
333:     for arm in entry.method.ARMS:
334:         c["pooling_stats"] = {}
335:         model, optimizer, initial = entry.fresh(c)
336:         entry.method.bind(model, entry.method.metadata(arm))
337:         manifest["initials"][arm] = initial
338:         if initial != baseline["initial_identity"] or parent.adam_step(optimizer) != 0:
339:             raise ValueError("Independent identical untrained starts required")
340:         memory = None
341:         for stage, d in enumerate("AB", 1):
342:             name = d+"_"+arm
343:             if stage == 2:
344:                 manifest["starts"][arm] = continuity(model, optimizer, memory)
345:                 if manifest["starts"][arm] != manifest["points"]["A_"+arm]["continuity"]:
346:                     raise ValueError("B did not continue its own restored A state")
347:             current = domain("fit", d)
348:             log, captures = entry.train_stage(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm, stage, root, budget)
349:             endpoint, memory = entry.checkpoint(root, name, model, optimizer, memory, current if stage==1 else None,
350:                 domain("calibration", d), valid, c, arm, stage, budget)
351:             manifest["training"][name], manifest["diagnostics"][name], manifest["points"][name] = log, captures, endpoint
352:             manifest["physical_updates"] += 288
353:             manifest["gradient_group_presentations"] += 288*stage
354:             data.write_json(root/"progress.json", manifest)
355:         del model, optimizer, memory
356:         gc.collect()
357:         if torch.cuda.is_initialized():
358:             torch.cuda.empty_cache()
359:     manifest["status"] = entry.COMPLETE
360:     data.write_json(root/"manifest.json", manifest)
361:     for source in manifest["source_files"]:
362:         destination = root/"sources"/source["path"]
363:         destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
364:         shutil.copyfile(data.verify(data.ROOT/source["path"], source), destination)
365:     return manifest, split, valid, metadata

368: def blind_gate(root: Path, manifest: dict, *, entry=None) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
369:     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
370:     if (manifest["status"] != entry.COMPLETE or manifest["source_files"] != entry.sources()

373:             or any(set(manifest[k]) != set(entry.method.ARMS) for k in ("starts", "initials"))):
374:         raise ValueError("Incomplete source-bound blind experiment")
375:     baseline, old_root, old_col, old_manifest = entry.baseline_inputs()
376:     if manifest.get("baseline_identity") != data.record(entry.BASELINE, data.ROOT):
377:         raise ValueError("Baseline provenance missing")

379:     if split != data.read_json(old_root/"run/partition.json"):
380:         raise ValueError("Frozen baseline partition differs")
381:     valid_ids = [r["group_uid"] for r in split["development"]]
382:     if len(valid_ids) != 40 or any(sum(r["domain"] == d for r in split["development"]) != 20 for d in "AB"):
383:         raise ValueError("AB valid coverage differs")
384:     fit = {r["group_uid"]: r["domain"] for r in split["fit"]}
385:     canonical = sorted(u for u, domain in fit.items() if domain == "A")
386:     if len(canonical) != 48:
387:         raise ValueError("Shared A fit scope differs")
388:     a_point = manifest["points"]["A_"+entry.method.ARMS[0]]
389:     shared = record.Memory.from_bytes(data.verify(root/a_point["memory"]["path"], a_point["memory"]).read_bytes())
390:     members = shared.summary()["members"]
391:     rng = random.Random(data.seed_for(20260930, "ABC", "retention"))
392:     retained = []
393:     for seen, uid in enumerate(sorted(canonical), 1):
394:         k = seen-1 if seen <= 6 else rng.randrange(seen)
395:         if k < 6:
396:             if k == len(retained):
397:                 retained.append(uid)
398:             else:
399:                 retained[k] = uid
400:     if retained != members:
401:         raise ValueError("Independent Algorithm R differs")
402:     for arm in entry.method.ARMS:
403:         if (manifest["initials"][arm] != baseline["initial_identity"]
404:                 or manifest["starts"][arm] != manifest["points"]["A_"+arm]["continuity"]):
405:             raise ValueError("Independent starts/own A continuation missing")
406:     scores, sequences = {}, {1: [], 2: []}
407:     for name in entry.POINTS:
408:         point = manifest["points"][name]
409:         arm, stage = name[2:], "AB".index(name[0])+1
410:         a_point = manifest["points"]["A_"+arm]
411:         if (point["arm"] != arm or point["stage"] != stage or point["adam_step"] != stage*288
412:                 or point["full_restore_verified"] is not True or point["inference_restore_verified"] is not True
413:                 or any(point.get(k) != v for k, v in entry.method.metadata(arm).items())):
414:             raise ValueError("Endpoint restoration missing")

417:         expected_fit = [r["group_uid"] for r in split["fit"] if r["domain"] == "AB"[stage-1]]
418:         stream = data.seed_for(20260918, "ABC", stage, "current")
419:         expected = data.schedule([type("ID", (), {"uid": u})() for u in expected_fit], 6, stream)
420:         if log["updates"] != 288 or len(log["rows"]) != 288 or log["adam_step"] != stage*288 or log["current_ids"] != [g.uid for g in expected]:
421:             raise ValueError("Main schedule/update count differs")

423:         if (memory.summary() != point["memory_summary"] or memory.reservoir.seen != 48 or memory.summary()["members"] != members

29: def state(model, optimizer):
30:     return cpu_copy({"model": model.state_dict(), "adam": optimizer.state_dict(),
31:                      "grads": [p.grad for p in model.parameters()]})

33: 
34: def restore(model, optimizer, saved, rng, modes):
35:     model.load_state_dict(saved["model"])
36:     optimizer.load_state_dict(cpu_copy(saved["adam"]))
37:     for p, g in zip(model.parameters(), saved["grads"], strict=True):
38:         p.grad = None if g is None else g.to(p.device)
39:     for m, mode in zip(model.modules(), modes, strict=True):
40:         m.training = mode
41:     diag.restore_rng(rng)
42: 
43: 
44: def adam_effects(model, optimizer, saved):
45:     """Record on/off Adam states by actual optimizer parameter ID and model name."""
46:     current = optimizer.state_dict()
47:     if [g["params"] for g in current["param_groups"]] != [g["params"] for g in saved["param_groups"]]:
48:         raise ValueError("On/off Adam parameter mapping differs")
49:     names = {id(p): name for name, p in model.named_parameters()}
50:     result = {component: {"finite": True, "parameters": []} for component in ("encoder", "head")}
51:     for live, packed in zip(optimizer.param_groups, current["param_groups"], strict=True):
52:         for parameter, pid in zip(live["params"], packed["params"], strict=True):
53:             name = names[id(parameter)]
54:             component = name.split(".", 1)[0]
55:             before, after = saved["state"].get(pid), current["state"].get(pid)
56:             row = {"name": name, "optimizer_parameter_id": pid, "state_present": after is not None}
57:             if (before is None) != (after is None) or (after is None and parameter.grad is not None):
58:                 raise ValueError("On/off Adam participation differs: "+name)
59:             if after is not None:
60:                 for key in ("step", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
61:                     if key not in before or key not in after:
62:                         raise ValueError("Missing on/off Adam field: "+name+"/"+key)
63:                     a, b = before[key], after[key].detach().cpu()
64:                     if a.shape != b.shape or a.dtype != b.dtype or not torch.isfinite(a).all() or not torch.isfinite(b).all():
65:                         raise ValueError("Invalid on/off Adam field: "+name+"/"+key)
66:                     row[key] = {"max_abs_delta": float((a-b).abs().max())}
67:                     if key == "step":
68:                         row[key].update(off=float(a), on=float(b))
69:             result[component]["parameters"].append(row)
70:     return result
71: 
72: 
73: def component_effects(model, on, *, optimizer=None):
74:     """Compare active paths; unused parameters must keep both mask and value."""
75:     parameters = list(model.named_parameters())
76:     effects = {}
77:     for component in ("encoder", "head"):
78:         active, inactive = [], []
79:         for i, (name, parameter) in enumerate(parameters):
80:             if not name.startswith(component+"."):
81:                 continue
82:             gradient, previous = parameter.grad, on["grads"][i]
83:             if (gradient is None) != (previous is None):
84:                 raise ValueError("On/off gradient participation changed: "+name)
85:             if gradient is None:
86:                 if not torch.equal(on["model"][name], parameter.detach().cpu()):
87:                     raise ValueError("Unused parameter changed: "+name)
88:                 inactive.append(name)
89:             else:
90:                 if not torch.isfinite(gradient).all() or not torch.isfinite(previous).all():
91:                     raise ValueError("Nonfinite on/off gradient: "+name)
92:                 active.append((i, name, parameter))
93:         gradient_delta = max((float((on["grads"][i]-p.grad.detach().cpu()).abs().max()) for i, n, p in active), default=0.)
94:         parameter_delta = max((float((on["model"][n]-p.detach().cpu()).abs().max()) for i, n, p in active), default=0.)
95:         if not active or gradient_delta == 0 or parameter_delta == 0:
96:             raise ValueError("No distinguishable encoder/head active update effect")
97:         effects[component] = {"post_clip_gradient_distinguishable": True, "actual_update_distinguishable": True,
98:             "finite": True, "active_grad_parameters": len(active), "inactive_grad_parameters": inactive,
99:             "active_parameter_names": [n for i, n, p in active],
100:             "post_clip_gradient_max_delta": gradient_delta, "parameter_max_delta": parameter_delta}
101:     if optimizer is not None:
102:         for component, value in adam_effects(model, optimizer, on["adam"]).items():
103:             effects[component]["adam"] = value
104:     return effects

113: def disk_reserve(path, total, reserve, maximum):
114:     if total+reserve > maximum or shutil.disk_usage(path).free < reserve:
115:         raise RuntimeError("Qualification checkpoint reserve exceeds available disk or approved work bytes")

123: def native(check, progress, handwritten, out, *, entry=None, consistency=False):
124:     run = entry or sys.modules["step28_g_half_run"]
125:     method = run.method
126:     active, control = method.ARMS[0], "H" if consistency else "G"
127:     import step28_balanced_pooling as original
128:     resources = preflight()
129:     if shutil.disk_usage(out).free < 10*2**30:
